message:
Fix call UX, swipe-to-regen, orb animations, and last-call banner

Call screen:
- Reduce call start delay 500ms→150ms (speech recognition starts faster)
- More exciting orb animations: 4 orbs (was 3), faster cycles (4-7s
  vs 8-12s), wider translation range (75% vs 55%), opacity pulse
- Add pulsing glow ring animation to character avatar
- Add 4th call-orb-4 element in HTML and mobile media-query override

Swipe to regenerate (mobile + desktop):
- Lower minimum distance threshold 60px→40px
- Relax diagonal constraint 0.8→0.9 (more tolerant of slight angles)
- Increase timeout 500/600ms→700ms (user has more time to swipe)

"One call left" banner:
- Fix condition: callsRemaining<=1 → callsRemaining===0
  (banner now fires only when THIS call is the last one, not before)
- Update text: "1 voice call left today" → "This is your last call today"
